exposure: pregnancy-related factors (e.g., BMI, waist circumference, parity, stretch marks, varicose veins)
baseline Inter-recti distance (IRD) at gestation week 16-19
cohort: 120 healthy pregnant women who provided baseline information before gestation week 20.
finding: Only baseline Inter-recti distance (IRD) was significantly associated with IRD at gestation week 37, predicting an average increase of 0.8 mm in IRD at gestation week 37 for each 1 mm increase in baseline IRD.
